 Thiagarajar College of Engineering
 where quality and ethics matter
 INDUSTRY & ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
 TCE’s Technology Business Incubator (TBI) nurtured 12 startups, including EVVI Solutions and Aura MEP, through infrastructure and mentorship.
 The Institution Innovation Council (IIC) signed 29 MoUs with industries and raised ₹99.58 lakh in consultancy revenue.
 Hosted MSME Hackathon 4.0, granting ₹15 lakh for student innovations.
 Centers like TSSCAR and CEEPT offer industrial training, prototyping, and testing support, bridging academia and industry.
 Regular collaboration with Thoughtworks, Amazon, BHEL, and IIT Bombay enables real-time exposure to emerging technologies.
  
 RANKING & RECOGNITION 
 NAAC A++ Accreditation (CGPA 3.56/4.00) in Cycle II and NBA Accredited Programmes, reinforcing quality education standards.
 NIRF 2025 Rankings: Engineering in the 101–150 band
 NIRF 2025 Rankings: Architecture and Planning ranked 33rd in India
 Featured in Times Higher Education (THE) Rankings 2025, 2026 across multiple bands
 Featured in QS World University Rankings: Asia 2026
 4th position in T-Schools DataQuest Award 2025 and  AAAA+ Rating from Careers 360 in 2024
 Excellence in Innovation & IIC Best Practices Award at the IIC Southern Regional Meet 2025  More Details 
  
 RESEARCH & INNOVATION 
 Awarded 589 PhDs to date; 68 scholars supported under Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF).
 Achieved 1,595 WoS and 4,432 Scopus-indexed publications with 42 design patents filed.
 Strong global collaborations with DRDO, IITs, CIPET, and University of Nottingham.
 Centres of Excellence like MuthirAI (AI in Tamil) and AWS, IBM & Bentley CoEs fuel interdisciplinary research and innovation.
  
 PLACEMENTS & INTERNSHIPS 
 Highest package: ₹28 LPA and average package: ₹7.25 LPA during the academic year 2024–25.
 Over 100 recruiters, including 25+ core engineering companies and 20+ super dream companies, hired students across diverse domains.
 345 students secured internships at leading organizations such as KLA Tencor, HPE Aruba, Caterpillar, Contentstack, and Texas Instruments, providing valuable real-world exposure and industry experience.
 The highest internship stipend reached ₹1 lakh per month, reflecting the strong industry demand for our students.
 The curriculum is closely aligned with industry requirements, complemented by MOOCs, Coursera, and NPTEL certifications to enhance students’ technical and professional competencies.

 TESTIMONIALS
 I am immensely thankful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for its significant contribution to my academic and personal development. Being part of the Class of 2025 with good academic performance, I credit the college for shaping me into a confident and capable individual. The faculty not only provided a solid understanding of academic concepts but also encouraged us to think creatively and go beyond the boundaries of textbooks. The college's efforts extended beyond regular academic hours, offering additional opportunities for learning, exploring new ideas, and improving technical and non-technical skills. I am thrilled to share that I secured placement in EmbedUR Systems, a reputed organization, through my very first interview. The college played a crucial role in preparing me for this opportunity by helping me approach it with confidence and without fear. TCE has been instrumental in helping me strengthen my technical knowledge and guiding me in developing essential non-technical skills such as communication, adaptability, and time management, making me industry-ready. Thank you, TCE, for being a cornerstone of my success. I will always cherish the invaluable experiences and knowledge gained during my time here.
 POO ANNAMALAI V 
 (2021 – 2025) 
 Electronics and Communications Engineering 
 EmbedUR Systems 
 I would like to express my sincere gratitude to my college and placement cell for their pivotal role in helping me secure my position as an Embedded-Motor Control Engineer at Johnson Electric. The knowledge I gained in key subjects like Power Electronics, C Language, and Control Systems has been instrumental in my role. I deeply appreciate the efforts of my faculty, whose teachings laid a strong foundation for my career. Their guidance and expertise have shaped me into the professional I am today.
 MUTHAIAH M 
 (2020 – 2024) 
 Mechatronics 
 Johnson Electrics 
 I am deeply grateful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for playing a pivotal role in my academic and personal growth. Graduating in 2025 with good performance is a proud milestone, and I owe this achievement to the relentless support and guidance of the faculty and management. The faculty at TCE have been instrumental in shaping my academic journey by ensuring a strong grasp of concepts while encouraging me to think creatively and critically beyond the confines of textbooks. The institution’s focus on cutting-edge infrastructure, comprehensive placement support, and a nurturing atmosphere has significantly contributed to my personal and professional development. I am proud to tell that I have secured a position at Infosys, a prestigious organization, thanks to the excellent placement initiatives provided by the college. The rigorous training programs, practice interviews, and personalized career guidance were key in building my confidence for the corporate world. I deeply thank the assistance offered in guiding me to the interview in Chennai, which proved to be immensely helpful. I am sincerely grateful to TCE for laying the foundation of my career. The knowledge, experiences, and memories I’ve gained here will always remain close to my heart.
 S SURIYA RAMKUMAR 
 (2021 – 2025) 
 Electronics and Communications Engineering 
 Infosys

I was given the chance to participate in a Caterpillar Company on-campus placement, which allowed me to demonstrate my technical expertise in a professional setting. I am incredibly grateful to my college for teaching me all facets of the workplace, which enhanced not only my professional skills but also my character and leadership abilities, and for giving me a job in a positive work-life balance

Graduating as a rank holder in 2023 is a proud milestone, and I owe this achievement to the relentless support and guidance of the faculty and management. The dedicated teaching staff not only ensured a thorough understanding of academic concepts but also encouraged us to explore beyond textbooks, fostering critical thinking and innovation. The management's focus on providing state-of-the-art facilities, comprehensive placement training, and a nurturing environment helped me develop both professionally and personally. I am delighted to share that I am now placed in HPE Aruba Networking, a reputed organization, thanks to the excellent placement opportunities provided by the college. The regular training sessions, mock interviews, and career guidance were instrumental in preparing me to confidently face the corporate world. Thank you, TCE, for being a cornerstone in shaping my future. I will always cherish the invaluable experiences and knowledge gained here.

 Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE)" has been a cornerstone in shaping my career. The Mechatronics department's well-rounded curriculum, blending theory with practical applications, and the placement cell's tireless efforts have equipped me with the skills needed to excel in the industry. Securing a position as an Embedded Software Developer at Caterpillar, a globally reputed organization, is a testament to this preparation. The role offers not only a competitive package but also exceptional opportunities for professional growth and innovation. I am proud to begin my career in a company that perfectly aligns with my field of study, and I remain deeply grateful to TCE for its unwavering support and guidance.
 Aishwarya K J V 
 (2020 – 2024) 
 Mechatronics 
 Caterpillar 
 Thiagarajar College of Engineering has been instrumental in my academic and personal development. It's a gratifying accomplishment to graduate first class with distinction, and I credit the management, professors and friends for their unwavering support and guidance. In addition to guaranteeing a thorough comprehension of useful industry topics, the dedicated and motivating mentors in the department encouraged me to think creatively by bringing in courses like Design Thinking, System Thinking, etc. I was able to build a diverse skill set because of the leadership's focus on fostering a collaborative work atmosphere, giving me access to cutting-edge labs, and planning effective training sessions and design-thinking workshops. I was able to develop both professionally and emotionally as a result of this rewarding experience, which gave me confidence and priceless insights for my future undertakings. The college is very well known for its great placement prospects and I am happy to share that I have been placed at Caterpillar Inc. I was well-prepared to confront the corporate world with confidence thanks to the mock interviews, both technical and non-technical, aptitude training classes and career guidance programs. Sessions in modern computing languages acted as a spring board to scale the corporate skies. My thanks to my parents for placing me in an institution that was friendly and professional in equal measures. I am confident that the knowledge and skills I gained will help me succeed in the years to come.

 (2020 – 2024)

(2020 – 2024)
B.Tech Computer Science and Business Systems

The college's support extended to co-curricular activities like participating in hackathons, which enhanced my technical and teamwork skills. This, along with the placement coaching, encouragement, and guidance I received, helped me secure a position at Caterpillar Inc., an MNC.

RAMYAVARSHINI P
(2020 – 2024)
B.Tech Computer Science and Business Systems
 

My time at Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE) has been transformative. The rigorous Data Science syllabus, the project I worked on during my 7th-semester internship, and the extensive coding practice have been instrumental in securing my role as a Software Engineer at Caterpillar. Being a student at TCE played a major role in getting placed at Cat Digital, as it visits only four colleges in Tamil Nadu for on-campus placements, and TCE is one among them. Additionally, the placement preparation classes from the 4th year and the help of my teachers throughout played a crucial role in helping me get placed. The data engineering concepts we studied in college are directly applicable in my current role as a DataOps Engineer, and I am thrilled to be part of such a prestigious company. I am grateful for the opportunities and support provided by the college, which have been pivotal in my journey. I look forward to contributing to the industry and making a positive impact.

J. B. Varsha Devi
(2019 – 2024)
M.Sc. Data Science
Caterpillar

I am deeply grateful to my institution for their constant support and guidance throughout my journey. Their excellent training, resources, and encouragement played a crucial role in helping me secure a job as an Associate Software Engineer in Caterpillar. The dedicated faculty and placement team provided opportunities that prepared me for the professional world. I sincerely thank them for fostering an environment of learning and growth that allowed me to achieve this milestone.

Aishwarya R
(2019 – 2024)
M.Sc. Data Science
Caterpillar

I am deeply grateful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for the amazing education I received during my M.Sc. in Data Science. A big thank you to the Department of Data Science, especially our faculty, staff, and Head of Department, for their constant support and guidance. The department provided great opportunities for growth through training, workshops, and industry programs. Guest lectures by experts gave me valuable insights into real-world data science. Placement training sessions played a key role in preparing me for interviews and helped me secure a job at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). I’m proud to be an alumnus of TCE and will always cherish the knowledge and memories I gained here. Thank you for shaping my journey and success.

Logeshwaran R
(2019 – 2024)
M.Sc. Data Science
Caterpillar

I'm truly grateful to the placement cell for providing me with opportunities that have significantly contributed to my career growth. The aptitude and programming training sessions boosted my confidence and prepared me well for interviews, and as a result I got placed in Hyundai Motors India Limited. I'm thankful for the continuous support and motivation from the faculty, which played a key role in my success.

Sabrina Ashley M
(2020 – 2024)
Mechatronics
Hyundai

Thanks to the exceptional support and resources provided by TCE's placement cell, I was able to secure offer letter in Wipro. The placement training programs, sessions with alumni placed in the corresponding companies all these were extremely helpful in getting placed in a company. Being a Placement representative, it further provided valuable experience interacting with the recruiters and manage additional responsibilities too. I’m grateful for the college's commitment to ensuring that its students not only receive a quality education but also the tools and support needed to thrive professionally.

Preetham Meenaakshi L
(2019 – 2023)
Mechatronics
Wipro
Overall Best Outgoing Student - 2023 

Knowledge-enriching training sessions have been provided by my college placement cell, which aids in our personal development. Numerous reputable firms visited our college, allowing us to grow as individuals and prepare to be hired by one of them. I was placed at Hyundai Motor India Limited, a reputable corporation with a competitive compensation package, thanks to the assistance of my college placement cell. I want to express my sincere gratitude to the faculties and my placement coordinator for helping me during my needs.

Haritha M
(2020 – 2024)
Mechatronics
Hyundai

I'm proud to be an alumnus of Thiagarajar College of Engineering, where I earned my degree in Mechatronics Engineering. The program's unique blend of electrical, mechanical, and software engineering disciplines gave me a holistic understanding of complex systems. This foundation has been instrumental in my success as an Associate Design Engineer. I'm grateful for the strong foundation TCE provided. The mechatronics degree opened doors to exciting opportunities in automation, robotics, and design

Shajith Ahamed S
(2019 – 2023)
Mechatronics
Caterpillar

TCE provided a fantastic learning environment for my bachelor’s degree. We had a wide range of extracurricular activities and clubs that cater to diverse interests. Our college has an excellent placement record, ensuring we were able to secure rewarding careers. Additionally, the infrastructure and facilities are well-maintained and continuously upgraded. Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my time here and had a transformative experience! I secured a placement at Fidelity.

VISHAL TIWARI
(2020 – 2024)
B.E. – Electrical and Electronics Engineering
 

I am immensely grateful to TCE for providing me with the incredible opportunity to be placed in Microchip Technology through the campus hiring process. The dedicated efforts of the placement cell, combined with the comprehensive academic curriculum, have played a pivotal role in shaping my career.

NAVEEN V
(2020 – 2024)
B.E. – Electrical and Electronics Engineering
 

My experience at TCE was full of learning and grooming. I had a wonderful time developing my personal, social and professional skills at TCE. Supportive staffs, extra-curricular and co-curricular activities boosted up my self-esteem. The magnificent architecture and the pleasant environment of the institution delivers positive energy. I was offered with a good and effective placement training. This plays a vital role for me to get placed in Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

NIKILA P K
(2020 – 2024)
B.E. – Electrical and Electronics Engineering
 

I am deeply grateful to our college Thiagarajar College of Engineering Madurai for the excellent environment given which contributed to my overall development in my career. The Professors who taught me were so inspiring that we on our own went into depths to understand the basics well which made us what we are in our life today. My Heartfelt Pranaams to all professors and college staff

Subramanian MK
Sr. Vice President
1996 batch - EEE
Head – Material Handling Equipment
TKIL Industries Pune

I am deeply grateful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for providing the strong academic foundation, discipline, and confidence that have guided me throughout my professional journey. 
The education and mentorship I received at TCE helped me build a career spanning more than 17 years in enterprise data architecture, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and large-scale technology platforms. I have had the opportunity to contribute to organizations including American Express, JPMorgan Chase, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Amazon Web Services, Southwest Airlines, and Duke Energy. 
I currently work as a Sr.Solutions Architect – Data & AI, designing enterprise-scale cloud, data, automation, and Generative AI solutions. I sincerely thank the faculty and management of TCE for fostering an environment of learning, leadership, and continuous growth. I am proud to be a TCE alumnus and look forward to supporting and inspiring future generations of students.

Sundhar Alagumalai 
2009 batch
Information technology
Senior Solutions Architect – Data & AI ,New Math Data,USA

Being a student at Thiagarajar College of Engineering has been an experience filled with learning, growth, and meaningful opportunities. What I really appreciate is how our department creates space for students to grow beyond academics through hackathons, research, and student-led initiatives. TCE’s professional societies, technical clubs, and non-technical clubs offer many opportunities to learn and grow outside the classroom. Taking up leadership responsibilities in such spaces helped me build confidence, leadership, and teamwork skills that I’ll always value. The support and placement opportunities I found here played an important role in helping me secure a position through the Software Engineer Program at JPMorgan Chase.

Anushri T
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Computer Science and Business Systems
JPMorgan Chase

TCE has been a really exciting place to learn and grow. Our department was supportive in all possible ways, and our staff made concepts easy to understand and apply. There were plenty of co-curricular and extra-curricular opportunities through various clubs, both technical and non-technical, allowing us to participate in and conduct several events, along with opportunities like attending international conferences. The strong connection with TBI and the focus on entrepreneurial thinking really stood out here. The campus is full of trees, making it aesthetic and vibrant. Placements had very good opportunities for many students, and I got the opportunity to secure a full-time role at Fidelity Investments. I’m grateful for all the people and connections I made here. Overall, it was a fun and enriching experience.

Murugappan V 
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Computer Science and Business Systems
Fidelity Investments

My journey at TCE has been truly enriching, with a strong academic foundation, excellent infrastructure, and dedicated placement support. Serving as the Overall General Secretary of Shrishti Cultural Association was a defining experience that strengthened my leadership, teamwork, and organizational skills. The exposure to both technical and extracurricular opportunities played a key role in shaping my confidence and overall personality. I’m grateful to TCE for the guidance and opportunities that helped me secure a rewarding career opportunity and take the next step with confidence. The support and placement opportunities I found here played an important role in helping me secure a position through the SDE role at Amazon.

Hrishikesan S 
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Computer Science and Business Systems
Amazon

With continuous guidance and exposure to real industry-level challenges, I was able to perform well across assessments, hackathons and interviews. My project experience and hands-on development skills were key in demonstrating my technical understanding during interviews. 
I am grateful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for the support and opportunities that helped me secure my placement and start my professional journey.

Gururaja R 
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Information Technology
Caterpillar Inc.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for playing a significant role in shaping me into a confident IT professional. The institution has provided me with an excellent academic foundation, practical exposure, and countless opportunities that have prepared me for the corporate world. 
I extend my sincere appreciation to the Placement Cell and all the Placement Coordinators for their continuous efforts in bringing leading organizations to our campus and providing students with excellent career opportunities. Their guidance, training, and support throughout the placement process were invaluable.
I am proud to share that I have been placed at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) as a System/Software Engineer. This milestone reflects the strong academic foundation and industry-oriented learning I received at Thiagarajar College of Engineering. I am especially grateful to my faculty members for their constant guidance, encouragement, and unwavering support throughout my academic journey.
I will always be grateful to Thiagarajar College of Engineering for providing an environment that fosters learning, growth, and professional excellence. It is an honor to be an alumna of this prestigious institution, and I sincerely thank everyone who contributed to my journey.

Remila Joys Mary
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Information Technology
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)

Looking back on my journey, every step of the way was shaped by the constant encouragement and guidance of the Information Technology Department. From placement training sessions to continuous mentoring, the faculty members were always approachable, supportive, and dedicated to helping us achieve our goals. The well-designed curriculum and the hands-on projects we completed each semester strengthened my technical knowledge and gave me the confidence to apply it in real-world situations. These experiences played a significant role in helping me secure my placement at IDFC FIRST Bank. It has been a truly rewarding journey, and I will always cherish the support, mentorship, and opportunities my department provided in shaping my career.

Nirutthyusha
(2022 – 2026)
B.Tech Information Technology
IDFC First

Thiagarajar College of Engineering: A Journey into the Founding Vision
TCE’s Technology Business Incubator (TBI) nurtured 12 startups, including EVVI Solutions and Aura MEP, through infrastructure and mentorship.
The Institution Innovation Council (IIC) signed 29 MoUs with industries and raised ₹99.58 lakh in consultancy revenue.
Hosted MSME Hackathon 4.0, granting ₹15 lakh for student innovations.
Centers like TSSCAR and CEEPT offer industrial training, prototyping, and testing support, bridging academia and industry.
Regular collaboration with Thoughtworks, Amazon, BHEL, and IIT Bombay enables real-time exposure to emerging technologies.
NAAC A++ Accreditation (CGPA 3.56/4.00) in Cycle II and NBA Accredited Programmes, reinforcing quality education standards.
NIRF 2025 Rankings: Engineering in the 101–150 band
NIRF 2025 Rankings: Architecture and Planning ranked 33rd in India
Featured in Times Higher Education (THE) Rankings 2025, 2026 across multiple bands
Featured in QS World University Rankings: Asia 2026
4th position in T-Schools DataQuest Award 2025 and  AAAA+ Rating from Careers 360 in 2024
Excellence in Innovation & IIC Best Practices Award at the IIC Southern Regional Meet 2025 More Details
Awarded 589 PhDs to date; 68 scholars supported under Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF).
Achieved 1,595 WoS and 4,432 Scopus-indexed publications with 42 design patents filed.
Strong global collaborations with DRDO, IITs, CIPET, and University of Nottingham.
Centres of Excellence like MuthirAI (AI in Tamil) and AWS, IBM & Bentley CoEs fuel interdisciplinary research and innovation.
Highest package: ₹28 LPA and average package: ₹7.25 LPA during the academic year 2024–25.
Over 100 recruiters, including 25+ core engineering companies and 20+ super dream companies, hired students across diverse domains.

345 students secured internships at leading organizations such as KLA Tencor, HPE Aruba, Caterpillar, Contentstack, and Texas Instruments, providing valuable real-world exposure and industry experience.
The highest internship stipend reached ₹1 lakh per month, reflecting the strong industry demand for our students.
The curriculum is closely aligned with industry requirements, complemented by MOOCs, Coursera, and NPTEL certifications to enhance students’ technical and professional competencies.

 Management 
 Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar
1893 - 1974 
 Founder 
 Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar was a great visionary with a mission. He was entrusted with the moral and social responsibility of building this institution with the objective of serving society. A staunch nationalist and a distinguished industrialist, he led a life of sacrifice. He was an exceptional educationalist with a keen focus on transforming lives through education. As a remarkable social savant, he left his footprints in the sands of time across all facets of social life. A dedicated reader, his passion for language was evident in his profound command of the Tamil language. As a generous philanthropist through his righteous deeds, he continues to live in the hearts of many. Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar was a holistic personality with a spiritual aura and soul.
 Dr. Mrs. Radha Thiagarajan
1926 – 2013 
 Emeritus Chairman 
 Dr. Mrs. Radha Thiagarajan was the first Vice Chancellor of Alagappa University and served two terms in the post. She is gifted with the gab and is considered an eminent multilingual scholar. She is acclaimed as one of the most widely respected academicians, known for her sound knowledge and intelligence. She rendered her service to society by being a member of several prestigious organizations. With a fervour for language and literature, she is a staunch patron of religious and literary scholars. Throughout all walks of her life, she has carried herself as an epitome of love and care, through her generous contributions to noble causes. Today, she is revered and admired as a respected mother figure by many.
 Mr. Karumuttu T.Kannan
1953 - 2023 
 Former Chairman & Correspondent 
 Mr. Karumuttu T. Kannan, Chairman & Correspondent of Thiagarajar College of Engineering, holds the prestigious position of Member of the Tamil Nadu State Planning Commission, Chennai. He is also a Member of the Planning Board of Madurai Kamaraj University. Built on values and principles, he is a visionary leader with a relentless desire to serve humanity. As a dynamic industrialist and seasoned educationalist, he has over 30 years of experience in college administration. He has proven himself to be an able entrepreneurial leader and philanthropist, with an inimitable ability to steer institutions to greater heights. His passion for the arts and literature has made him a custodian of Indian culture, arts, traditions, and heritage.
 Mr. K. Hari Thiagarajan 
 Chairman & Correspondent 
 K. Hari Thiagarajan was born on 2nd August, 1988, and is the son of Sri. & Smt. Karumuttu T. Kannan and grandson of Sri & Smt. Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar.
 Graduated from the University of Warwick, UK with a degree in Engineering Management.
 Managing Director of Thiagarajar Mills (P) Ltd., Madurai.
 Chairman & Managing Director of VTM Limited, Virudhunagar.
 Secretary of Thiagarajar College [Arts & Science], Madurai and Chairman & Correspondent of Thiagarajar College of Engineering,Madurai.
 Past Chairman of CII (Confederation of Indian Industry), Tamil Nadu State Council.
 Member of Entrepreneurs’ Organization, Chennai Chapter.
 Executive Committee Member of SIMA (The Southern India Mills’ Association), Coimbatore.
 He is passionate about classical Tamil literature & Sanskrit. His other interests include photography, reading, cycling & mentoring potential entrepreneurs

Founder

Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar (1893 - 1974)

Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar was a great visionary with a noble mission. He was entrusted with the moral and social responsibility of building this institution with the objective of serving society. A staunch nationalist and a remarkable industrialist, he led a life of sacrifice. He was also an exceptional educationalist, with a keen focus on transforming lives through education. As a prominent social reformer, he left an indelible mark on all aspects of social life. A devoted reader, his passion for language was evident in his profound command of Tamil. As a generous philanthropist through his righteous deeds, he continues to live in the hearts of many. Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar had a holistic personality that radiated spiritual aura and wisdom.

MISSION

 We at TCE shall strive continuously to

  • Achieve academic excellence in Science, Engineering and Technology through dedication to duty, commitment to research, innovation in learning and faith in human values.

  • Enable the students to develop into outstanding professionals with high ethical standards capable of creating, developing and managing global engineering enterprises.

  • Fulfil expectations of the society and industry by equipping students with state of art technology resources for developing sustainable solutions.

  • Achieve these through team efforts making Thiagarajar College of Engineering, the socially diligent trend setter in technical education.

 

Quality Policy

 

We are committed to create quality professionals to meet the emerging industrial and social needs through,

  • Innovative teaching

  • Applied research

  • Industrial interaction

  • Placing faith in human values

  • Aiming at continual improvement in all activities

 Administration 
 Dr. L. Ashok Kumar
principal [at] tce [dot] edu 
 Principal 
 Dr. L. Ashok Kumar was a Postdoctoral Research Fellow from San Diego State University, California. He was selected among seven scientists in India for the BHAVAN Fellowship from the Indo-US Science and Technology Forum and also, he received SYST Fellowship from DST, Govt. of India. Currently working as a Principal, Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, Tamil Nadu He has 3 years of industrial experience and 25 years of academic and research experience in PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore. He has published 173 technical papers in International and National journals and presented 167 papers in National and International Conferences. He has completed 28 Government of India funded projects worth about 15 Crores and currently 9 projects are in progress worth about 13 Crores. He has developed 27 products and out of that 23 products have been technology transferred to industries and for Government funding agencies.
 He has created Eight Centres of Excellence at PSG Tech in collaboration with Government agencies and Industries. His PhD work on wearable electronics earned him a National Award from ISTE, and he has received 27 awards in the National and in International level. He has guided 92 graduate and postgraduate projects. He has produced 13 PhD Scholars and 12 candidates are doing PhD under his supervision. He has visited many countries for institute industry collaboration and as a keynote speaker. He has been an invited speaker in 373 programs. Also, he has organized 112 events, including conferences, workshops, and seminars. He completed his graduate program in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from University of Madras and his post-graduate from PSG College of Technology, India, and Masters in Business Administration from IGNOU, New Delhi. After completion of his graduate degree, he joined as project engineer for Serval Paper Boards Ltd., Coimbatore (now ITC Unit, Kovai). He is also a Certified Charted Engineer and BSI Certified ISO 500001 2008 Lead Auditor. He has authored 32 books in his areas of interest published by  Springer, CRC Press, Elsevier, Nova Publishers, Cambridge University Press, Wiley, Lambert Publishing and IGI Global and also contributed 36 chapters in various books. He has 11 patents, one Design patent and five Copyrights  to his credit He is also the Chairman of Indian Association of Energy Management Professionals and Executive Member in Institution of Engineers, Coimbatore, Vice President of Sustainability and Energy Practitioners Association, Executive Council Member in Institute of Smart Structure and Systems, Bangalore, Associate Member in CODISSIA. He is also holding prestigious positions in various national and international forums and he is a Fellow Member in IET (UK), Fellow Member in IETE, Fellow Member in IE and Senior Member in IEEE. He has been appointed as Nodal Officer for Technology Enabling Centre, Anna University to strengthen industry - Academic interaction and to promote Technology Development Ecosystem.

 Dr. S. Rajaram
registrar [at] tce [dot] edu 
 Registrar 
 Dr. S. Rajaram is a distinguished academician and researcher with over 27 years of experience. He currently serves as the Registrar and Professor in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, India. Dr. Rajaram completed his Ph.D. in VLSI Design and conducted postdoctoral research in 3D wireless system design at Georgia Institute of Technology, USA.
 Dr. Rajaram has published over 268 research papers, authored 19 book chapters, and guided 10 Ph.D. scholars. He has coordinated several sponsored research projects funded by AICTE, DST, and RCI. In addition, he holds multiple patents in wearable medical devices, air pollutant filtration, and assistive technologies. 
An active member in Institution of Engineering and Technology and senior member of IEEE, Dr. S. Rajaram has received numerous accolades, including the Young Scientist Fellowship from TNSCST and the BOYSCAST Fellowship from DST, New Delhi. He is the recipient of Cambridge International Certification for Teachers. His consultancy work includes collaborations with companies like Honeywell and Cognizant in wireless and communication technologies.

He completed his graduate program in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from University of Madras and his post-graduate from PSG College of Technology, India, and Masters in Business Administration from IGNOU, New Delhi. After completion of his graduate degree, he joined as project engineer for Serval Paper Boards Ltd., Coimbatore (now ITC Unit, Kovai). He is also a Certified Charted Engineer and BSI Certified ISO 500001 2008 Lead Auditor. He has authored 32 books in his areas of interest published by  Springer, CRC Press, Elsevier, Nova Publishers, Cambridge University Press, Wiley, Lambert Publishing and IGI Global and also contributed 36 chapters in various books. He has 11 patents, one Design patent and five Copyrights  to his credit He is also the Chairman of Indian Association of Energy Management Professionals and Executive Member in Institution of Engineers, Coimbatore, Vice President of Sustainability and Energy Practitioners Association, Executive Council Member in Institute of Smart Structure and Systems, Bangalore, Associate Member in CODISSIA. He is also holding prestigious positions in various national and international forums and he is a Fellow Member in IET (UK), Fellow Member in IETE, Fellow Member in IE and Senior Member in IEEE. He has been appointed as Nodal Officer for Technology Enabling Centre, Anna University to strengthen industry - Academic interaction and to promote Technology Development Ecosystem.

Registrar

Dr. S. Rajaram is a distinguished academician and researcher with over 27 years of experience. He currently serves as the Registrar and Professor in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, India. Dr. Rajaram completed his Ph.D. in VLSI Design and conducted postdoctoral research in 3D wireless system design at Georgia Institute of Technology, USA.

Dr. Rajaram has published over 268 research papers, authored 19 book chapters, and guided 10 Ph.D. scholars. He has coordinated several sponsored research projects funded by AICTE, DST, and RCI. In addition, he holds multiple patents in wearable medical devices, air pollutant filtration, and assistive technologies.
An active member in Institution of Engineering and Technology and senior member of IEEE, Dr. S. Rajaram has received numerous accolades, including the Young Scientist Fellowship from TNSCST and the BOYSCAST Fellowship from DST, New Delhi. He is the recipient of Cambridge International Certification for Teachers. His consultancy work includes collaborations with companies like Honeywell and Cognizant in wireless and communication technologies.

 About the College 
 Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE) is as a Government Aided Autonomous Institution, established in 1957 by the philanthropist Late Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar. TCE is affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, and approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). TCE offers a wide array of Undergraduate, Postgraduate and Ph.D. Programs across various disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Science. The campus is set within a serene and eco-friendly environment surrounded by dense vegetation and best infrastructure facilities.
 Each academic Department at TCE is dedicated to a specific theme, fostering synergy between faculty and students in academic and research endeavours. These themes encompass diverse areas such as Eco-friendly Structures, Power and Energy, Automation, Automotive, Wireless Technologies, Distributed Computing, Database Management, Modelling and Simulation, Material Science, Green Chemistry, and Heritage.
 TCE has consistently embraced reforms and upgrades in its Teaching-Learning processes. Noteworthy initiatives include the implementation of a Competency-Based Curriculum and Outcome-Based Education. Since 2018, TCE has adopted the Conceive Design Implement Operate (CDIO) framework, shaping curriculum design, pedagogical methods, and assessment techniques, with adequate hands-on training to students. The institution has also launched Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) in 2021 and introduced the Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF) scheme for Ph.D. research scholars, furthering its commitment to academic excellence and research innovation.
 The college maintains active industry collaborations with leading global organizations. These collaborations have resulted in the establishment of state-of-the-art laboratories, industry-oriented curriculum design, collaborative projects, professional training programs, student internships, and placements. For instance, Subject Matter Experts from TVS Motors have collaborated with TCE faculty to co-create the curriculum for Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering programs, in addition to the establishment of T S Srinivasan Centre for Automotive Research.
 TCE's active participation in the Technical Education Quality Improvement Programme (TEQIP) under the National Project Implementation Unit (NPIU) of the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) has led to innovative teaching and learning processes, faculty development programs, industry-supported research activities, and good governance initiatives.
 TCE is involved in national and international ranking frameworks, showcasing its commitment to excellence and quality in education. The institution's programs have been accredited by NBA since 1998, indicating compliance with quality standards in technical education. The programmes offered at institution has garnered numerous accolades, including accreditation by NAAC with a CGPA of 3.56 (out of 4.0) with A ++ Grade in Cycle 2.  Engineering departments have been recognized with the "Best Industry Linked Technical Institutions award” by AICTE and the Confederation of Indian Industries (CII). Faculty members have earned International Certification in Engineering Education by IUCEE, Cambridge International certification and Wipro Mission 10x. Dr. R. Vasudevan, Professor in the Chemistry Department, received the "Padma Shri" for his pioneering work on plastic roads. TCE students have actively participated and succeeded in events like the Smart India Hackathon (SIH), showcasing their talent and problem-solving abilities.

TCE has consistently embraced reforms and upgrades in its Teaching-Learning processes. Noteworthy initiatives include the implementation of a Competency-Based Curriculum and Outcome-Based Education.  History & Values
 History & Values 
 1957 - 1967 
 1957 - Pre-Engineering introduced
 1958 - University of Madras grants affiliation for B.E. Civil, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering
 1959 - 5 year B.Sc. degree courses introduced
 1966 - 3year B.Sc. degree courses introduced. Affiliated to newly formed Madurai University
 1967 - 1977 
 1968 - Subject unit system introduced
 1969 - Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry departments recognized as centres for PhD research
 1971 - Part-time B.E. Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, M.Sc. Structural Engineering (Civil), M.Sc. Power system Engineering (Electrical) introduced
 1972 - Civil and Electrical Engineering departments recognized as centres for PhD research
 1973 - B.Sc. (Applied Sciences) introduced
 1975 - TEMCOS(Thiagarajar Engineering and Management Consultancy Services) started
 1976 - Semester system introduced
 1977 - 1987 
 1978 - B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering and M.Sc. Applied Mathematics introduced. M.Sc. Engineering renamed as M.E. dregree. Madurai University renamed as Madurai Kamaraj University
 1980 - Duration of B.E. degree reduced to 4 years
 1984 - ​B.E. Computer Science and Engineering introduced
 1985 - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) introduced
 1986 - M.E. Industrial Engineering and M.Sc. Applied Chemistry introduced
 1987 - 1997 
 1987 - Autonomous status conferred by the University
 1995 - B.Arch. and M.E. Communication Systems introduced
 1997 - M.E. Production Engineering introduced. B.E. Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Computer Science, ME Structural Engg, ME Power Systems Engineering and MCA courses are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation
 1997 - 2007 
 1998 - B.E. Mechatronics introduced.
 1999 - B.Tech Information Technology introduced
 2000 - M.Sc. Material Science Technology introduced. AICTE sanctions additional in - take of 150 students in B.E. ECE, CSE, IT and 30 students in M.C.A degree courses
 2001 - B.E. Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Course introduced. M.E. Computer Science and Engineering introduced. Affiliation of the college transferred from Madurai Kamaraj University to Anna University. Dept. of ECE, CSE, & Mech. Engineering recognized as centres for PhD research by M.K.University.
 2003 - Ladies hostel started in TCE Campus
 2005 - CCC was etablshed with 24/7 computing facility
 2005 - Thiagarajar Advanced Research Center(TARC)  started
 2006 - M.Tech. Environmental Engineering introduced
 2006 - Re accreditation of all UG Programs
 2006 - TCE awarded first Patent from the Government of India for New Mix design of Waste Plastics
 2007 - Golden Jubilee celebrations
 2007 - M.Tech Environmental Engineering  introduced
 2007 - 2017 
 2009 - New I.T Block started
 2009 - Agreement with Yahoo! for cloud computing
 2010 - Indoor stadium established
 2012 - TTSL inaugurated
 2013 - TBI started
 2014 - Introduction of B.E. and M.E Programme in Mechatronics
 2015 - MSME Department of India has sanctioned Business Incubator to TCE
 2016 - Govt of TN recognized TCE as Entrepreneurship Development Hub (IEDP) Promotion Institute
 2016 - Starting of Department of Mechatronics
 2017 - Inauguration of Thiagarajar Entrepreneur Network (TEN)
 2017 - TCE signs MoU with Indonesia Government for laying plastic road
 2017 - 2024 
 2018 - Starting of Bentley supported Building Information Modelling BIM Lab
 2018 - Commencement of TCE Environmental Information System TCE ENVIS - Centre for Plastic Waste Management
 2018 - Dr. R. Vasudevan, Professor, Dept of Chemistry, TCE receives Padma Shri Award for Road using Waste Plastic 2018 - TCE signs MoU with National Entrepreneurship Network
 2018 - Implementation of Conceive Design Implement Operate (CDIO) Framework for UG Curriculum
 2019 - Commencement of 5 Year Integrated MSc (Data Science) Degree Programme
 2019 - Inauguration of T. S. Srinivasan Centre for Automative Research (TSS Car)
 2019 - Inauguration of TCE - AVM Centre for testing and calibration
 2019 - 60th Year Celebrations with 6T Conclave
 2019 - Commencement of TCE and Indo Universal Collaboration for Engineering Education (IUCEE)
 2019 - NAAC Cycle 1 Accreditation: A+ Grade with 3.47 points out of 4

History & Values

Breadcrumb

  1. Home >
  2. History & Values

History & Values

1957 - 1967

  • 1957 - Pre-Engineering introduced
  • 1958 - University of Madras grants affiliation for B.E. Civil, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering
  • 1959 - 5 year B.Sc. degree courses introduced
  • 1966 - 3year B.Sc. degree courses introduced. Affiliated to newly formed Madurai University

1967 - 1977

  • 1968 - Subject unit system introduced
  • 1969 - Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry departments recognized as centres for PhD research
  • 1971 - Part-time B.E. Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, M.Sc. Structural Engineering (Civil), M.Sc. Power system Engineering (Electrical) introduced
  • 1972 - Civil and Electrical Engineering departments recognized as centres for PhD research
  • 1973 - B.Sc. (Applied Sciences) introduced
  • 1975 - TEMCOS(Thiagarajar Engineering and Management Consultancy Services) started
  • 1976 - Semester system introduced

1977 - 1987

  • 1978 - B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering and M.Sc. Applied Mathematics introduced. M.Sc. Engineering renamed as M.E. dregree. Madurai University renamed as Madurai Kamaraj University
  • 1980 - Duration of B.E. degree reduced to 4 years
  • 1984 - ​B.E. Computer Science and Engineering introduced
  • 1985 - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) introduced
  • 1986 - M.E. Industrial Engineering and M.Sc. Applied Chemistry introduced

1987 - 1997

  • 1987 - Autonomous status conferred by the University
  • 1995 - B.Arch. and M.E. Communication Systems introduced
  • 1997 - M.E. Production Engineering introduced. B.E. Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Computer Science, ME Structural Engg, ME Power Systems Engineering and MCA courses are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation

1997 - 2007

  • 1998 - B.E. Mechatronics introduced.
  • 1999 - B.Tech Information Technology introduced
  • 2000 - M.Sc. Material Science Technology introduced. AICTE sanctions additional in - take of 150 students in B.E. ECE, CSE, IT and 30 students in M.C.A degree courses
  • 2001 - B.E. Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Course introduced. M.E. Computer Science and Engineering introduced. Affiliation of the college transferred from Madurai Kamaraj University to Anna University. Dept. of ECE, CSE, & Mech. Engineering recognized as centres for PhD research by M.K.University.
  • 2003 - Ladies hostel started in TCE Campus
  • 2005 - CCC was etablshed with 24/7 computing facility
  • 2005 - Thiagarajar Advanced Research Center(TARC)  started
  • 2006 - M.Tech. Environmental Engineering introduced
  • 2006 - Re accreditation of all UG Programs
  • 2006 - TCE awarded first Patent from the Government of India for New Mix design of Waste Plastics
  • 2007 - Golden Jubilee celebrations
  • 2007 - M.Tech Environmental Engineering  introduced

2007 - 2017

  • 2009 - New I.T Block started
  • 2009 - Agreement with Yahoo! for cloud computing
  • 2010 - Indoor stadium established
  • 2012 - TTSL inaugurated
  • 2013 - TBI started
  • 2014 - Introduction of B.E. and M.E Programme in Mechatronics
  • 2015 - MSME Department of India has sanctioned Business Incubator to TCE
  • 2016 - Govt of TN recognized TCE as Entrepreneurship Development Hub (IEDP) Promotion Institute
  • 2016 - Starting of Department of Mechatronics
  • 2017 - Inauguration of Thiagarajar Entrepreneur Network (TEN)
  • 2017 - TCE signs MoU with Indonesia Government for laying plastic road

2017 - 2024

  • 2018 - Starting of Bentley supported Building Information Modelling BIM Lab
  • 2018 - Commencement of TCE Environmental Information System TCE ENVIS - Centre for Plastic Waste Management
  • 2018 - Dr. R. Vasudevan, Professor, Dept of Chemistry, TCE receives Padma Shri Award for Road using Waste Plastic 2018 - TCE signs MoU with National Entrepreneurship Network
  • 2018 - Implementation of Conceive Design Implement Operate (CDIO) Framework for UG Curriculum
  • 2019 - Commencement of 5 Year Integrated MSc (Data Science) Degree Programme
  • 2019 - Inauguration of T. S. Srinivasan Centre for Automative Research (TSS Car)
  • 2019 - Inauguration of TCE - AVM Centre for testing and calibration
  • 2019 - 60th Year Celebrations with 6T Conclave
  • 2019 - Commencement of TCE and Indo Universal Collaboration for Engineering Education (IUCEE)
  • 2019 - NAAC Cycle 1 Accreditation: A+ Grade with 3.47 points out of 4
  • 2020 - Commencement of 4 year B.TECH Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS) Degree Programme
  • 2021 - Launch of TCE Online Courses
  • 2022 - Setting up of ENVIS - EIACP Centre sponsored by Ministry of Environment, Forests & Climate Change, Government of India
  • 2023 - Promotion of Research through Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF)
  • 2024 - Commencement of B.Des. (Interior Design) Degree Programme
  • 2024 - Commencement of M.Plan (Urban Planning)
  • 2024 - Commencement of B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (AI&ML) Degree Programme

 INDUSTRY & ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
 TCE’s Technology Business Incubator (TBI) nurtured 12 startups, including EVVI Solutions and Aura MEP, through infrastructure and mentorship.
 The Institution Innovation Council (IIC) signed 29 MoUs with industries and raised ₹99.58 lakh in consultancy revenue.
 Hosted MSME Hackathon 4.0, granting ₹15 lakh for student innovations.
 Centers like TSSCAR and CEEPT offer industrial training, prototyping, and testing support, bridging academia and industry.
 Regular collaboration with Thoughtworks, Amazon, BHEL, and IIT Bombay enables real-time exposure to emerging technologies.
  
 RANKING & RECOGNITION 
 NAAC A++ Accreditation (CGPA 3.56/4.00) in Cycle II and NBA Accredited Programmes, reinforcing quality education standards.
 NIRF 2025 Rankings: Engineering in the 101–150 band
 NIRF 2025 Rankings: Architecture and Planning ranked 33rd in India
 Featured in Times Higher Education (THE) Rankings 2025, 2026 across multiple bands
 Featured in QS World University Rankings: Asia 2026
 4th position in T-Schools DataQuest Award 2025 and  AAAA+ Rating from Careers 360 in 2024
 Excellence in Innovation & IIC Best Practices Award at the IIC Southern Regional Meet 2025  More Details 
  
 RESEARCH & INNOVATION 
 Awarded 589 PhDs to date; 68 scholars supported under Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF).
 Achieved 1,595 WoS and 4,432 Scopus-indexed publications with 42 design patents filed.
 Strong global collaborations with DRDO, IITs, CIPET, and University of Nottingham.
 Centres of Excellence like MuthirAI (AI in Tamil) and AWS, IBM & Bentley CoEs fuel interdisciplinary research and innovation.
  
 PLACEMENTS & INTERNSHIPS 
 Highest package: ₹28 LPA and average package: ₹7.25 LPA during the academic year 2024–25.
 Over 100 recruiters, including 25+ core engineering companies and 20+ super dream companies, hired students across diverse domains.
 345 students secured internships at leading organizations such as KLA Tencor, HPE Aruba, Caterpillar, Contentstack, and Texas Instruments, providing valuable real-world exposure and industry experience.
 The highest internship stipend reached ₹1 lakh per month, reflecting the strong industry demand for our students.
 The curriculum is closely aligned with industry requirements, complemented by MOOCs, Coursera, and NPTEL certifications to enhance students’ technical and professional competencies.

 Management
 Management 
 Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar
1893 - 1974 
 Founder 
 Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar was a great visionary with a mission. He was entrusted with the moral and social responsibility of building this institution with the objective of serving society. A staunch nationalist and a distinguished industrialist, he led a life of sacrifice. He was an exceptional educationalist with a keen focus on transforming lives through education. As a remarkable social savant, he left his footprints in the sands of time across all facets of social life. A dedicated reader, his passion for language was evident in his profound command of the Tamil language. As a generous philanthropist through his righteous deeds, he continues to live in the hearts of many. Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar was a holistic personality with a spiritual aura and soul.
 Dr. Mrs. Radha Thiagarajan
1926 – 2013 
 Emeritus Chairman 
 Dr. Mrs. Radha Thiagarajan was the first Vice Chancellor of Alagappa University and served two terms in the post. She is gifted with the gab and is considered an eminent multilingual scholar. She is acclaimed as one of the most widely respected academicians, known for her sound knowledge and intelligence. She rendered her service to society by being a member of several prestigious organizations. With a fervour for language and literature, she is a staunch patron of religious and literary scholars. Throughout all walks of her life, she has carried herself as an epitome of love and care, through her generous contributions to noble causes. Today, she is revered and admired as a respected mother figure by many.
 Mr. Karumuttu T.Kannan
1953 - 2023 
 Former Chairman & Correspondent 
 Mr. Karumuttu T. Kannan, Chairman & Correspondent of Thiagarajar College of Engineering, holds the prestigious position of Member of the Tamil Nadu State Planning Commission, Chennai. He is also a Member of the Planning Board of Madurai Kamaraj University. Built on values and principles, he is a visionary leader with a relentless desire to serve humanity. As a dynamic industrialist and seasoned educationalist, he has over 30 years of experience in college administration. He has proven himself to be an able entrepreneurial leader and philanthropist, with an inimitable ability to steer institutions to greater heights. His passion for the arts and literature has made him a custodian of Indian culture, arts, traditions, and heritage.
 Mr. K. Hari Thiagarajan 
 Chairman & Correspondent 
 K. Hari Thiagarajan was born on 2nd August, 1988, and is the son of Sri. & Smt. Karumuttu T. Kannan and grandson of Sri & Smt. Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar.
 Graduated from the University of Warwick, UK with a degree in Engineering Management.
 Managing Director of Thiagarajar Mills (P) Ltd., Madurai.
 Chairman & Managing Director of VTM Limited, Virudhunagar.
 Secretary of Thiagarajar College [Arts & Science], Madurai and Chairman & Correspondent of Thiagarajar College of Engineering,Madurai.
 Past Chairman of CII (Confederation of Indian Industry), Tamil Nadu State Council.
 Member of Entrepreneurs’ Organization, Chennai Chapter.
 Executive Committee Member of SIMA (The Southern India Mills’ Association), Coimbatore.
 He is passionate about classical Tamil literature & Sanskrit. His other interests include photography, reading, cycling & mentoring potential entrepreneurs

He was entrusted with the moral and social responsibility of building this institution with the objective of serving society. A staunch nationalist and a remarkable industrialist, he led a life of sacrifice. He was also an exceptional educationalist, with a keen focus on transforming lives through education. As a prominent social reformer, he left an indelible mark on all aspects of social life. A devoted reader, his passion for language was evident in his profound command of Tamil. As a generous philanthropist through his righteous deeds, he continues to live in the hearts of many. Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar had a holistic personality that radiated spiritual aura and wisdom.

 Vision & Mission
 Vision & Mission 
 VISION 
   To provide world class quality technical education with strong ethical values.
 MISSION 
  We at TCE shall strive continuously to
 Achieve academic excellence in Science, Engineering and Technology through dedication to duty, commitment to research, innovation in learning and faith in human values.
 Enable the students to develop into outstanding professionals with high ethical standards capable of creating, developing and managing global engineering enterprises.
 Fulfil expectations of the society and industry by equipping students with state of art technology resources for developing sustainable solutions.
 Achieve these through team efforts making Thiagarajar College of Engineering, the socially diligent trend setter in technical education.
  
 Quality Policy 
  
 We are committed to create quality professionals to meet the emerging industrial and social needs through,
 Innovative teaching
 Applied research
 Industrial interaction
 Placing faith in human values
 Aiming at continual improvement in all activities

 Dr. L. Ashok Kumar
principal [at] tce [dot] edu 
 Principal 
 Dr. L. Ashok Kumar was a Postdoctoral Research Fellow from San Diego State University, California. He was selected among seven scientists in India for the BHAVAN Fellowship from the Indo-US Science and Technology Forum and also, he received SYST Fellowship from DST, Govt. of India. Currently working as a Principal, Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, Tamil Nadu He has 3 years of industrial experience and 25 years of academic and research experience in PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore. He has published 173 technical papers in International and National journals and presented 167 papers in National and International Conferences. He has completed 28 Government of India funded projects worth about 15 Crores and currently 9 projects are in progress worth about 13 Crores. He has developed 27 products and out of that 23 products have been technology transferred to industries and for Government funding agencies.
 He has created Eight Centres of Excellence at PSG Tech in collaboration with Government agencies and Industries. His PhD work on wearable electronics earned him a National Award from ISTE, and he has received 27 awards in the National and in International level. He has guided 92 graduate and postgraduate projects. He has produced 13 PhD Scholars and 12 candidates are doing PhD under his supervision. He has visited many countries for institute industry collaboration and as a keynote speaker. He has been an invited speaker in 373 programs. Also, he has organized 112 events, including conferences, workshops, and seminars. He completed his graduate program in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from University of Madras and his post-graduate from PSG College of Technology, India, and Masters in Business Administration from IGNOU, New Delhi. After completion of his graduate degree, he joined as project engineer for Serval Paper Boards Ltd., Coimbatore (now ITC Unit, Kovai). He is also a Certified Charted Engineer and BSI Certified ISO 500001 2008 Lead Auditor. He has authored 32 books in his areas of interest published by  Springer, CRC Press, Elsevier, Nova Publishers, Cambridge University Press, Wiley, Lambert Publishing and IGI Global and also contributed 36 chapters in various books. He has 11 patents, one Design patent and five Copyrights  to his credit He is also the Chairman of Indian Association of Energy Management Professionals and Executive Member in Institution of Engineers, Coimbatore, Vice President of Sustainability and Energy Practitioners Association, Executive Council Member in Institute of Smart Structure and Systems, Bangalore, Associate Member in CODISSIA. He is also holding prestigious positions in various national and international forums and he is a Fellow Member in IET (UK), Fellow Member in IETE, Fellow Member in IE and Senior Member in IEEE. He has been appointed as Nodal Officer for Technology Enabling Centre, Anna University to strengthen industry - Academic interaction and to promote Technology Development Ecosystem.

 Registrar 
 Dr. S. Rajaram is a distinguished academician and researcher with over 27 years of experience. He currently serves as the Registrar and Professor in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, India. Dr. Rajaram completed his Ph.D. in VLSI Design and conducted postdoctoral research in 3D wireless system design at Georgia Institute of Technology, USA.
 Dr. Rajaram has published over 268 research papers, authored 19 book chapters, and guided 10 Ph.D. scholars. He has coordinated several sponsored research projects funded by AICTE, DST, and RCI. In addition, he holds multiple patents in wearable medical devices, air pollutant filtration, and assistive technologies. 
An active member in Institution of Engineering and Technology and senior member of IEEE, Dr. S. Rajaram has received numerous accolades, including the Young Scientist Fellowship from TNSCST and the BOYSCAST Fellowship from DST, New Delhi. He is the recipient of Cambridge International Certification for Teachers. His consultancy work includes collaborations with companies like Honeywell and Cognizant in wireless and communication technologies.

 About The College
 About the College 
 Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE) is as a Government Aided Autonomous Institution, established in 1957 by the philanthropist Late Karumuttu Thiagarajan Chettiar. TCE is affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, and approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). TCE offers a wide array of Undergraduate, Postgraduate and Ph.D. Programs across various disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Science. The campus is set within a serene and eco-friendly environment surrounded by dense vegetation and best infrastructure facilities.
 Each academic Department at TCE is dedicated to a specific theme, fostering synergy between faculty and students in academic and research endeavours. These themes encompass diverse areas such as Eco-friendly Structures, Power and Energy, Automation, Automotive, Wireless Technologies, Distributed Computing, Database Management, Modelling and Simulation, Material Science, Green Chemistry, and Heritage.
 TCE has consistently embraced reforms and upgrades in its Teaching-Learning processes. Noteworthy initiatives include the implementation of a Competency-Based Curriculum and Outcome-Based Education. Since 2018, TCE has adopted the Conceive Design Implement Operate (CDIO) framework, shaping curriculum design, pedagogical methods, and assessment techniques, with adequate hands-on training to students. The institution has also launched Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) in 2021 and introduced the Thiagarajar Research Fellowship (TRF) scheme for Ph.D. research scholars, furthering its commitment to academic excellence and research innovation.
 The college maintains active industry collaborations with leading global organizations. These collaborations have resulted in the establishment of state-of-the-art laboratories, industry-oriented curriculum design, collaborative projects, professional training programs, student internships, and placements. For instance, Subject Matter Experts from TVS Motors have collaborated with TCE faculty to co-create the curriculum for Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering programs, in addition to the establishment of T S Srinivasan Centre for Automotive Research.
 TCE's active participation in the Technical Education Quality Improvement Programme (TEQIP) under the National Project Implementation Unit (NPIU) of the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) has led to innovative teaching and learning processes, faculty development programs, industry-supported research activities, and good governance initiatives.
 TCE is involved in national and international ranking frameworks, showcasing its commitment to excellence and quality in education. The institution's programs have been accredited by NBA since 1998, indicating compliance with quality standards in technical education. The programmes offered at institution has garnered numerous accolades, including accreditation by NAAC with a CGPA of 3.56 (out of 4.0) with A ++ Grade in Cycle 2.  Engineering departments have been recognized with the "Best Industry Linked Technical Institutions award” by AICTE and the Confederation of Indian Industries (CII). Faculty members have earned International Certification in Engineering Education by IUCEE, Cambridge International certification and Wipro Mission 10x. Dr. R. Vasudevan, Professor in the Chemistry Department, received the "Padma Shri" for his pioneering work on plastic roads. TCE students have actively participated and succeeded in events like the Smart India Hackathon (SIH), showcasing their talent and problem-solving abilities.
